[20] tc0  touchcap
    val = 0
    on down:
        sleep_display.en=1
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        // tc (Touch Controller) for initiating GESTURE processing.
        // (can only have ONE tcx component - lowest id number takes precedence, others ignored).
        // Event checking is done 'live' in GESTURE (or custom) timer.
        // Raise this componet to id 1 (highest precendence rank order).
        // All other UI Events need to be 'Touch Release Events'
        // (OR components need to be added to Exclusions below.)
        // Uses Global variables (in [Program.s] tab):
        //   int x=0,y=0,dx=0,dy=0,dsq=0,gest_time=0,gest_type=0
        //
        gest_time=0  // reset counter for press duration
        //
        // Set UI components to EXCLUDE from gestures (Sliders)
        // tc0.val -> component ID; b[tc0.val].type -> component type
        if(b[tc0.val].type==1)  // Sliders have component type == 1
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else if(b[tc0.val].type==98&&b[tc0.val].font==10)  // Buttons have component type == 98
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else
        {
          //NORMAL GESTURE processing
          GESTURE.en=1
        }
    on up:
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        GESTURE.en=0
        //
        //<- CUSTOM*** add generic long press release actions here
        if(gest_type==3)
        {
          //Down
          page home
        }else if(gest_type>=91)
        {
          if(tc0.val==21)
          {
            page home
          }else if(tc0.val==17)
          {
            page cleanscreen
          }
        }

[25] GESTURE  timer
    en = 0
    tim = 50
    on timer:
        //~~~~~~ boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.004 ***DEMO/DEBUG mods
        // GESTURE intpreter (press duration & swipes) (timer).
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        //*** CUSTOMIZE immediate (before realease) actions below for each page ***
        // Works with tc0 to continually poll gesture x,y,distance,duration
        // while a touch gesture is occurring (BEFORE Touch Release Event).
        // Gestures are decoded below 'live' and can be used to either:
        //  * execute an immediate action (before Touch Release Events), or
        //  * use `gest_type` as a condition/modifier in Touch Release Events.
        //---------------------
        //GESTURE list (returned in `gest_type` Global variable):
        //  -1: excluded UI component - sliders (+ custom***)
        //   0: invalid gesture (movement, but too short for swipe)
        //   1: right swipe
        //   2: left swipe
        //   3: down swipe
        //   4: up swipe
        //  91: short press (>90 => Press without x,y movement)
        //  92: long press
        //  93: very long press
        //---------------------
        //
        if(tch0>0)  //Skip last timer cycle where stroke ends (tch0=0) BEFORE tc0 stops this timer.
        {
          //
          // Monitor duration of gesture (using count of cycles of this timer)
          gest_time++
          //
          // Monitor distance of gesture movement (in pixels squared)
          dx=tch0-tch2
          dy=tch1-tch3
          dsq=dx*dx
          tmp=dy*dy
          dsq+=tmp  // easier to work with square of distance - no need to sqrt
          //
          //
          // Gesture interpretation
          gest_type=0  // not a valid gesture (yet)
          // Movement < 10px => PRESS(click) component
          if(dsq<100)
          {
            if(gest_time<10)
            {
              // o
              gest_type=91 // short press
              //t1.txt="o" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(gest_time<30)
            {
              // oo
              gest_type=92 // long press
              //t1.txt="oo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else
            {
              // ooo
              gest_type=93 // vlong press
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="ooo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
              if(gest_time==30)
              {
                //dim=0
                //dim=100
                //dim=dim_default
              }
            }
          }
          //
          // Movement > 100px => SWIPE
          if(dsq>10000)
          {
            if(dx>100)
            {
              //>>
              gest_type=1 // right
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt=">>" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dx<-100)
            {
              //<<
              gest_type=2 // left
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="<<" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy>100)
            {
              //vv
              gest_type=3 // down
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="vv" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy<-100)
            {
              //^^
              gest_type=4 // up
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="^^" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }
          }
          //
          //
          //
          //
          //DEBUG/DEMO display of live (pre-release) gesture internal data updates
          //n0.val=gest_time
          //n1.val=tch0
          //n2.val=dx
          //n3.val=tch1
          //n4.val=dy
          //n5.val=tc0.val  //component ID
          //n5.val=b[tc0.val].type // component type
          //n6.val=gest_type
          if(gest_type==0)
          {
            //Ambiguous/incomplete gesture - ignore
            //t1.txt="X" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
          }
        }

[14] sleep_display  timer
    en = 1
    tim = 30000
    on timer:
        printh 92 FF FF FF
[15] tc0  touchcap
    val = 0
    on down:
        sleep_display.en=1
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        // tc (Touch Controller) for initiating GESTURE processing.
        // (can only have ONE tcx component - lowest id number takes precedence, others ignored).
        // Event checking is done 'live' in GESTURE (or custom) timer.
        // Raise this componet to id 1 (highest precendence rank order).
        // All other UI Events need to be 'Touch Release Events'
        // (OR components need to be added to Exclusions below.)
        // Uses Global variables (in [Program.s] tab):
        //   int x=0,y=0,dx=0,dy=0,dsq=0,gest_time=0,gest_type=0
        //
        gest_time=0  // reset counter for press duration
        //
        // Set UI components to EXCLUDE from gestures (Sliders)
        // tc0.val -> component ID; b[tc0.val].type -> component type
        if(b[tc0.val].type==1)  // Sliders have component type == 1
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else if(b[tc0.val].type==98&&b[tc0.val].font==11)  // Buttons have component type == 98
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else
        {
          //NORMAL GESTURE processing
          GESTURE.en=1
        }
    on up:
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        GESTURE.en=0
        //
        //<- CUSTOM*** add generic long press release actions here
        if(gest_type==1)
        {
          //Right
          printh 65 06 0B 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type==2)
        {
          //Left
          printh 65 06 0D 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type==3)
        {
          //Down
          printh 65 06 0A 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type>=91)
        {
          if(tc0.val==1)
          {
            printh 65 06 01 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==2)
          {
            printh 65 06 02 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==3)
          {
            printh 65 06 03 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==4)
          {
            printh 65 06 04 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==10)
          {
            printh 65 06 0A 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==11)
          {
            printh 65 06 0B 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==13)
          {
            printh 65 06 0D 01 FF FF FF
          }
        }
[16] GESTURE  timer
    en = 0
    tim = 50
    on timer:
        //~~~~~~ boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.004 ***DEMO/DEBUG mods
        // GESTURE intpreter (press duration & swipes) (timer).
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        //*** CUSTOMIZE immediate (before realease) actions below for each page ***
        // Works with tc0 to continually poll gesture x,y,distance,duration
        // while a touch gesture is occurring (BEFORE Touch Release Event).
        // Gestures are decoded below 'live' and can be used to either:
        //  * execute an immediate action (before Touch Release Events), or
        //  * use `gest_type` as a condition/modifier in Touch Release Events.
        //---------------------
        //GESTURE list (returned in `gest_type` Global variable):
        //  -1: excluded UI component - sliders (+ custom***)
        //   0: invalid gesture (movement, but too short for swipe)
        //   1: right swipe
        //   2: left swipe
        //   3: down swipe
        //   4: up swipe
        //  91: short press (>90 => Press without x,y movement)
        //  92: long press
        //  93: very long press
        //---------------------
        //
        if(tch0>0)  //Skip last timer cycle where stroke ends (tch0=0) BEFORE tc0 stops this timer.
        {
          //
          // Monitor duration of gesture (using count of cycles of this timer)
          gest_time++
          //
          // Monitor distance of gesture movement (in pixels squared)
          dx=tch0-tch2
          dy=tch1-tch3
          dsq=dx*dx
          tmp=dy*dy
          dsq+=tmp  // easier to work with square of distance - no need to sqrt
          //
          //
          // Gesture interpretation
          gest_type=0  // not a valid gesture (yet)
          // Movement < 10px => PRESS(click) component
          if(dsq<100)
          {
            if(gest_time<10)
            {
              // o
              gest_type=91 // short press
              //t1.txt="o" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(gest_time<30)
            {
              // oo
              gest_type=92 // long press
              //t1.txt="oo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else
            {
              // ooo
              gest_type=93 // vlong press
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="ooo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
              if(gest_time==30)
              {
                //dim=0
                //dim=100
                //dim=dim_default
              }
            }
          }
          //
          // Movement > 100px => SWIPE
          if(dsq>10000)
          {
            if(dx>100)
            {
              //>>
              gest_type=1 // right
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt=">>" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dx<-100)
            {
              //<<
              gest_type=2 // left
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="<<" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy>100)
            {
              //vv
              gest_type=3 // down
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="vv" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy<-100)
            {
              //^^
              gest_type=4 // up
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="^^" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }
          }
          //
          //
          //
          //
          //DEBUG/DEMO display of live (pre-release) gesture internal data updates
          //n0.val=gest_time
          //n1.val=tch0
          //n2.val=dx
          //n3.val=tch1
          //n4.val=dy
          //n5.val=tc0.val  //component ID
          //n5.val=b[tc0.val].type // component type
          //n6.val=gest_type
          if(gest_type==0)
          {
            //Ambiguous/incomplete gesture - ignore
            //t1.txt="X" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
          }
        }

[23] tc0  touchcap
    val = 0
    on down:
        sleep_display.en=1
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        // tc (Touch Controller) for initiating GESTURE processing.
        // (can only have ONE tcx component - lowest id number takes precedence, others ignored).
        // Event checking is done 'live' in GESTURE (or custom) timer.
        // Raise this componet to id 1 (highest precendence rank order).
        // All other UI Events need to be 'Touch Release Events'
        // (OR components need to be added to Exclusions below.)
        // Uses Global variables (in [Program.s] tab):
        //   int x=0,y=0,dx=0,dy=0,dsq=0,gest_time=0,gest_type=0
        //
        gest_time=0  // reset counter for press duration
        //
        // Set UI components to EXCLUDE from gestures (Sliders)
        // tc0.val -> component ID; b[tc0.val].type -> component type
        if(b[tc0.val].type==1)  // Sliders have component type == 1
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else if(b[tc0.val].type==98&&b[tc0.val].font==11)  // Buttons have component type == 98
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else
        {
          //NORMAL GESTURE processing
          GESTURE.en=1
        }
    on up:
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        GESTURE.en=0
        //
        //<- CUSTOM*** add generic long press release actions here
        if(gest_type==1)
        {
          //Right
          printh 65 07 13 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type==2)
        {
          //Left
          printh 65 07 15 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type==3)
        {
          //Down
          printh 65 07 12 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type>=91)
        {
          if(tc0.val==1)
          {
            printh 65 07 01 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==2)
          {
            printh 65 07 02 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==3)
          {
            printh 65 07 03 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==4)
          {
            printh 65 07 04 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==5)
          {
            printh 65 07 05 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==6)
          {
            printh 65 07 06 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==7)
          {
            printh 65 07 07 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==8)
          {
            printh 65 07 08 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==18)
          {
            printh 65 07 12 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==19)
          {
            printh 65 07 13 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==21)
          {
            printh 65 07 15 01 FF FF FF
          }
        }
[24] GESTURE  timer
    en = 0
    tim = 50
    on timer:
        //~~~~~~ boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.004 ***DEMO/DEBUG mods
        // GESTURE intpreter (press duration & swipes) (timer).
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        //*** CUSTOMIZE immediate (before realease) actions below for each page ***
        // Works with tc0 to continually poll gesture x,y,distance,duration
        // while a touch gesture is occurring (BEFORE Touch Release Event).
        // Gestures are decoded below 'live' and can be used to either:
        //  * execute an immediate action (before Touch Release Events), or
        //  * use `gest_type` as a condition/modifier in Touch Release Events.
        //---------------------
        //GESTURE list (returned in `gest_type` Global variable):
        //  -1: excluded UI component - sliders (+ custom***)
        //   0: invalid gesture (movement, but too short for swipe)
        //   1: right swipe
        //   2: left swipe
        //   3: down swipe
        //   4: up swipe
        //  91: short press (>90 => Press without x,y movement)
        //  92: long press
        //  93: very long press
        //---------------------
        //
        if(tch0>0)  //Skip last timer cycle where stroke ends (tch0=0) BEFORE tc0 stops this timer.
        {
          //
          // Monitor duration of gesture (using count of cycles of this timer)
          gest_time++
          //
          // Monitor distance of gesture movement (in pixels squared)
          dx=tch0-tch2
          dy=tch1-tch3
          dsq=dx*dx
          tmp=dy*dy
          dsq+=tmp  // easier to work with square of distance - no need to sqrt
          //
          //
          // Gesture interpretation
          gest_type=0  // not a valid gesture (yet)
          // Movement < 10px => PRESS(click) component
          if(dsq<100)
          {
            if(gest_time<10)
            {
              // o
              gest_type=91 // short press
              //t1.txt="o" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(gest_time<30)
            {
              // oo
              gest_type=92 // long press
              //t1.txt="oo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else
            {
              // ooo
              gest_type=93 // vlong press
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="ooo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
              if(gest_time==30)
              {
                //dim=0
                //dim=100
                //dim=dim_default
              }
            }
          }
          //
          // Movement > 100px => SWIPE
          if(dsq>10000)
          {
            if(dx>100)
            {
              //>>
              gest_type=1 // right
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt=">>" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dx<-100)
            {
              //<<
              gest_type=2 // left
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="<<" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy>100)
            {
              //vv
              gest_type=3 // down
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="vv" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy<-100)
            {
              //^^
              gest_type=4 // up
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="^^" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }
          }
          //
          //
          //
          //
          //DEBUG/DEMO display of live (pre-release) gesture internal data updates
          //n0.val=gest_time
          //n1.val=tch0
          //n2.val=dx
          //n3.val=tch1
          //n4.val=dy
          //n5.val=tc0.val  //component ID
          //n5.val=b[tc0.val].type // component type
          //n6.val=gest_type
          if(gest_type==0)
          {
            //Ambiguous/incomplete gesture - ignore
            //t1.txt="X" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
          }
        }

[31] tc0  touchcap
    val = 0
    on down:
        sleep_display.en=1
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        // tc (Touch Controller) for initiating GESTURE processing.
        // (can only have ONE tcx component - lowest id number takes precedence, others ignored).
        // Event checking is done 'live' in GESTURE (or custom) timer.
        // Raise this componet to id 1 (highest precendence rank order).
        // All other UI Events need to be 'Touch Release Events'
        // (OR components need to be added to Exclusions below.)
        // Uses Global variables (in [Program.s] tab):
        //   int x=0,y=0,dx=0,dy=0,dsq=0,gest_time=0,gest_type=0
        //
        gest_time=0  // reset counter for press duration
        //
        // Set UI components to EXCLUDE from gestures (Sliders)
        // tc0.val -> component ID; b[tc0.val].type -> component type
        if(b[tc0.val].type==1)  // Sliders have component type == 1
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else if(b[tc0.val].type==98&&b[tc0.val].font==11)  // Buttons have component type == 98
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else
        {
          //NORMAL GESTURE processing
          GESTURE.en=1
        }
    on up:
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        GESTURE.en=0
        //
        //<- CUSTOM*** add generic long press release actions here
        if(gest_type==1)
        {
          //Right
          printh 65 08 1B 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type==2)
        {
          //Left
          printh 65 08 1D 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type==3)
        {
          //Down
          printh 65 08 1A 01 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type>=91)
        {
          if(tc0.val==1)
          {
            printh 65 08 01 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==2)
          {
            printh 65 08 02 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==3)
          {
            printh 65 08 03 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==4)
          {
            printh 65 08 04 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==5)
          {
            printh 65 08 05 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==6)
          {
            printh 65 08 06 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==7)
          {
            printh 65 08 07 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==8)
          {
            printh 65 08 08 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==9)
          {
            printh 65 08 09 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==10)
          {
            printh 65 08 0A 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==11)
          {
            printh 65 08 0B 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==12)
          {
            printh 65 08 0C 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==26)
          {
            printh 65 08 1A 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==27)
          {
            printh 65 08 1B 01 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==29)
          {
            printh 65 08 1D 01 FF FF FF
          }
        }
[32] GESTURE  timer
    en = 0
    tim = 50
    on timer:
        //~~~~~~ boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.004 ***DEMO/DEBUG mods
        // GESTURE intpreter (press duration & swipes) (timer).
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        //*** CUSTOMIZE immediate (before realease) actions below for each page ***
        // Works with tc0 to continually poll gesture x,y,distance,duration
        // while a touch gesture is occurring (BEFORE Touch Release Event).
        // Gestures are decoded below 'live' and can be used to either:
        //  * execute an immediate action (before Touch Release Events), or
        //  * use `gest_type` as a condition/modifier in Touch Release Events.
        //---------------------
        //GESTURE list (returned in `gest_type` Global variable):
        //  -1: excluded UI component - sliders (+ custom***)
        //   0: invalid gesture (movement, but too short for swipe)
        //   1: right swipe
        //   2: left swipe
        //   3: down swipe
        //   4: up swipe
        //  91: short press (>90 => Press without x,y movement)
        //  92: long press
        //  93: very long press
        //---------------------
        //
        if(tch0>0)  //Skip last timer cycle where stroke ends (tch0=0) BEFORE tc0 stops this timer.
        {
          //
          // Monitor duration of gesture (using count of cycles of this timer)
          gest_time++
          //
          // Monitor distance of gesture movement (in pixels squared)
          dx=tch0-tch2
          dy=tch1-tch3
          dsq=dx*dx
          tmp=dy*dy
          dsq+=tmp  // easier to work with square of distance - no need to sqrt
          //
          //
          // Gesture interpretation
          gest_type=0  // not a valid gesture (yet)
          // Movement < 10px => PRESS(click) component
          if(dsq<100)
          {
            if(gest_time<10)
            {
              // o
              gest_type=91 // short press
              //t1.txt="o" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(gest_time<30)
            {
              // oo
              gest_type=92 // long press
              //t1.txt="oo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else
            {
              // ooo
              gest_type=93 // vlong press
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="ooo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
              if(gest_time==30)
              {
                //dim=0
                //dim=100
                //dim=dim_default
              }
            }
          }
          //
          // Movement > 100px => SWIPE
          if(dsq>10000)
          {
            if(dx>100)
            {
              //>>
              gest_type=1 // right
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt=">>" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dx<-100)
            {
              //<<
              gest_type=2 // left
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="<<" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy>100)
            {
              //vv
              gest_type=3 // down
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="vv" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy<-100)
            {
              //^^
              gest_type=4 // up
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="^^" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }
          }
          //
          //
          //
          //
          //DEBUG/DEMO display of live (pre-release) gesture internal data updates
          //n0.val=gest_time
          //n1.val=tch0
          //n2.val=dx
          //n3.val=tch1
          //n4.val=dy
          //n5.val=tc0.val  //component ID
          //n5.val=b[tc0.val].type // component type
          //n6.val=gest_type
          if(gest_type==0)
          {
            //Ambiguous/incomplete gesture - ignore
            //t1.txt="X" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
          }
        }

[3] tc0  touchcap
    val = 0
    on down:
        sleep_display.en=1
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        // tc (Touch Controller) for initiating GESTURE processing.
        // (can only have ONE tcx component - lowest id number takes precedence, others ignored).
        // Event checking is done 'live' in GESTURE (or custom) timer.
        // Raise this componet to id 1 (highest precendence rank order).
        // All other UI Events need to be 'Touch Release Events'
        // (OR components need to be added to Exclusions below.)
        // Uses Global variables (in [Program.s] tab):
        //   int x=0,y=0,dx=0,dy=0,dsq=0,gest_time=0,gest_type=0
        //
        gest_time=0  // reset counter for press duration
        //
        // Set UI components to EXCLUDE from gestures (Sliders)
        // tc0.val -> component ID; b[tc0.val].type -> component type
        if(b[tc0.val].type==1)  // Sliders have component type == 1
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else if(b[tc0.val].type==98&&b[tc0.val].font==10)  // Buttons have component type == 98
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else
        {
          //NORMAL GESTURE processing
          GESTURE.en=1
        }
    on up:
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        GESTURE.en=0
        //
        //<- CUSTOM*** add generic long press release actions here
        if(gest_type==3)
        {
          //Down
          printh 65 09 01 00 FF FF FF
        }else if(gest_type>=91)
        {
          if(tc0.val==1)
          {
            printh 65 09 01 00 FF FF FF
          }else if(tc0.val==8)
          {
            printh 65 09 08 00 FF FF FF
          }
        }

[13] tc0  touchcap
    val = 0
    on down:
        sleep_display.en=1
        //~~~~~~boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.04
        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        // tc (Touch Controller) for initiating GESTURE processing.
        // (can only have ONE tcx component - lowest id number takes precedence, others ignored).
        // Event checking is done 'live' in GESTURE (or custom) timer.
        // Raise this componet to id 1 (highest precendence rank order).
        // All other UI Events need to be 'Touch Release Events'
        // (OR components need to be added to Exclusions below.)
        // Uses Global variables (in [Program.s] tab):
        //   int x=0,y=0,dx=0,dy=0,dsq=0,gest_time=0,gest_type=0
        //
        gest_time=0  // reset counter for press duration
        //
        // Set UI components to EXCLUDE from gestures (Sliders)
        // tc0.val -> component ID; b[tc0.val].type -> component type
        if(b[tc0.val].type==1)  // Sliders have component type == 1
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else if(b[tc0.val].type==98&&b[tc0.val].font==10)  // Buttons have component type == 98
        {
          gest_type=-1 // excluded component
        }else
        {
          //NORMAL GESTURE processing
          GESTURE.en=1
        }
    on up:

        // GESTURES
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

        //<- CUSTOM*** add generic long press release actions here

        {
          //Right
          setAction.txt="swiperight"

        {
          //Left
          setAction.txt="swipeleft"
        }else if(gest_type==3)

[14] setActive  variable

[15] GESTURE  timer
    en = 0
    tim = 50
    on timer:
        //~~~~~~ boilerplate~~~~ v0.5.004 ***DEMO/DEBUG mods
        // GESTURE intpreter (press duration & swipes) (timer).
        //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        //*** CUSTOMIZE immediate (before realease) actions below for each page ***
        // Works with tc0 to continually poll gesture x,y,distance,duration
        // while a touch gesture is occurring (BEFORE Touch Release Event).
        // Gestures are decoded below 'live' and can be used to either:
        //  * execute an immediate action (before Touch Release Events), or
        //  * use `gest_type` as a condition/modifier in Touch Release Events.
        //---------------------
        //GESTURE list (returned in `gest_type` Global variable):
        //  -1: excluded UI component - sliders (+ custom***)
        //   0: invalid gesture (movement, but too short for swipe)
        //   1: right swipe
        //   2: left swipe
        //   3: down swipe
        //   4: up swipe
        //  91: short press (>90 => Press without x,y movement)
        //  92: long press
        //  93: very long press
        //---------------------
        //
        if(tch0>0)  //Skip last timer cycle where stroke ends (tch0=0) BEFORE tc0 stops this timer.
        {
          //
          // Monitor duration of gesture (using count of cycles of this timer)
          gest_time++
          //
          // Monitor distance of gesture movement (in pixels squared)
          dx=tch0-tch2
          dy=tch1-tch3
          dsq=dx*dx
          tmp=dy*dy
          dsq+=tmp  // easier to work with square of distance - no need to sqrt
          //
          //
          // Gesture interpretation
          gest_type=0  // not a valid gesture (yet)
          // Movement < 10px => PRESS(click) component
          if(dsq<100)
          {
            if(gest_time<10)
            {
              // o
              gest_type=91 // short press
              //t1.txt="o" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(gest_time<30)
            {
              // oo
              gest_type=92 // long press
              //t1.txt="oo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else
            {
              // ooo
              gest_type=93 // vlong press
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="ooo" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
              if(gest_time==30)
              {
                //dim=0
                //dim=100
                //dim=dim_default
              }
            }
          }
          //
          // Movement > 100px => SWIPE
          if(dsq>10000)
          {
            if(dx>100)
            {
              //>>
              gest_type=1 // right
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt=">>" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dx<-100)
            {
              //<<
              gest_type=2 // left
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="<<" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy>100)
            {
              //vv
              gest_type=3 // down
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="vv" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }else if(dy<-100)
            {
              //^^
              gest_type=4 // up
              //page 0  // <- CUSTOM*** live action here
              //t1.txt="^^" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
            }
          }
          //
          //
          //
          //
          //DEBUG/DEMO display of live (pre-release) gesture internal data updates
          //n0.val=gest_time
          //n1.val=tch0
          //n2.val=dx
          //n3.val=tch1
          //n4.val=dy
          //n5.val=tc0.val  //component ID
          //n5.val=b[tc0.val].type // component type
          //n6.val=gest_type
          if(gest_type==0)
          {
            //Ambiguous/incomplete gesture - ignore
            //t1.txt="X" // ***DEGBUG/DEMO
          }
        }
